title: Expanding Stargate to Michigan
summary: OpenAI is expanding Stargate to Michigan with a new one-gigawatt campus that strengthens America’s AI infrastructure. The project will create jobs, drive investment, and support economic growth across the Midwest.
body: OpenAI is expanding Stargate to Michigan with a new one-gigawatt campus that strengthens America’s AI infrastructure. The project will create jobs, drive investment, and support economic growth across the Midwest.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布将其Stargate项目扩展至密歇根州，计划建设一座一吉瓦（1GW）规模的数据中心园区。此举旨在强化美国的AI基础设施，通过大规模能源与算力布局，为未来AI模型的持续迭代提供物理支撑，同时也反映了头部AI公司在能源与硬件设施上的战略布局。
